body:
The FP32 produces incorrect results, while FP16 works correctly.
### Describe the bug

```
import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

@triton.jit
def kernel(q_ptr, k_ptr, v_ptr, o_ptr,
           M: tl.constexpr,
           N: tl.constexpr,
           K: tl.constexpr,
           ):
    rm = tl.arange(0, M)   # (M,)
    rk = tl.arange(0, K)   # (K,)
    cn = tl.arange(0, N)   # (N,)

    q_ptrs = q_ptr + rm[:, None] * K + rk[None, :]
    q = tl.load(q_ptrs)    # (M, K)

    k_ptrs = k_ptr + rk[:, None] + cn[None, :] * K
    k = tl.load(k_ptrs)    # (K, N)

    v_ptrs = v_ptr + cn[:, None] * K + rk[None, :]
    v = tl.load(v_ptrs)    # (N, K)

    p = tl.dot(q, k, out_dtype=tl.float32)   # (M, N)
    p = p.to(q_ptr.type.element_ty)
    acc = tl.dot(p, v, out_dtype=tl.float32) # (M, K)

    o_ptrs = o_ptr + rm[:, None] * K + rk[None, :]
    tl.store(o_ptrs, acc.to(o_ptr.type.element_ty))


def triton_gemm(q, k, v):
    M, K = q.shape
    N, _ = k.shape
    out = torch.empty((M, K), device=q.device, dtype=q.dtype)
    print_ptr_offsets(M, N, K)
    kernel[(1,)](q, k, v, out, M, N, K)
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    dtype = torch.float32 # dtype=torch.float16 is correct
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    M, K, N = 32, 64, 32

    q = torch.randn((M, K), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
    k = torch.randn((N, K), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
    v = torch.randn((N, K), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")

    out = triton_gemm(q, k, v)

    ref = q @ k.T @ v

    torch.testing.assert_close(ref, out, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2)
    print("pass")

```
